integrity: A self-contained proof and reproducible standard-library verification program are included; no independent scientific audit has been undertaken.
scientific_limitations: Specific to ruler/Zimin prefixes and positional minimum-length palindrome partitions; optimal length was proved previously; earlier equivalent multiplicity formulas cannot be excluded. Finite checks do not prove the infinite claim.
title: Factorial multiplicities of optimal palindromic factorizations of Zimin prefixes
